messages:
Rae: weekend quickpoll 1: ramen crawl downtown at 12:30 or gravel bike loop out to the reservoir at 9am? whos in? :ramen: :biking_man:
Omar: ramen all the way. weather sounds iffy for a loop.
Bea: bike for me  fresh air > carbs (but i will nap like a champion if we ride).
Tom: i'll do ramen but only if we hit the little spot with yuzu tare.
Rae: @Tom yes that place! also their vegan miso is solid.
Omar: vote: ramen 2, bike 1.
Bea: if rain cancels we can pivot to ramen afterwards?
Rae: plan: check 7am weather thread, if <20% rain we go bike 9am meet lobby; else ramen 12:30.
SnackBot: Snack suggestion: bring electrolyte tabs for the bike or extra napkins for the ramen.
Tom: bringing cash and hand wipes. anyone want a spare seat for the ride? (i have two).
Bea: ask me again if we end up biking  might need a lift back if my tire drama continues.
Omar: either way, i'm in for post-activity pastries.
Rae: okay final: weather call tomorrow morning, but penciled in ramen 12:30 if no ride crew. see y'all!
